description: This file extends the `ProcessInfo` class in Swift to include utility properties and methods for environment detection, such as checking if the app is running for Xcode previews, resolving Nix deployment mode, detecting if running in Nix mode, and identifying if tests are running.

methods.name: isPreview
methods.description: Checks if the app is running in Xcode Preview mode by inspecting the 'XCODE_RUNNING_FOR_PREVIEWS' environment variable.

methods.name: resolveNixMode
methods.description: Determines if the current environment is in Nix mode based on environment variables, user defaults, and whether the app bundle is a .app.

methods.name: isNixMode
methods.description: Property that checks if the app is currently running in Nix mode by calling resolveNixMode with current environment and user defaults.

methods.name: isRunningTests
methods.description: Checks whether the code is executing within a test environment by examining loaded bundles and specific environment variables related to XCTest.
